subject: Saturday event details
text: We need a quick confirmation. The hiking club has twenty-three people joining Saturday. That number is likely to rise by four. Could your minibus take up to thirty? If not, please say now. The current booking assumes twenty. A late change may create a seating problem. Also, we want the drop-off point nearer the trailhead. Last month we walked an extra mile because the bus stopped at the lower lot. That was hard for two members with knee pain. Could the driver use the upper entrance if it is open? If it is closed, tell us the best fallback. We can meet everyone at the café instead. Another concern is parking. Some members drive. If the lot fills, could you suggest an overflow area? We also need an arrival time. Is ninety minutes still safe? We may need to start later if loading is slow. Please confirm the total cost for thirty people. If the price changes, send a revised quote before Friday. We will pay by transfer. Do you need full payment now or only after headcount? A practical note: please remind the driver to keep the door open for loading. We will bring folding stools. Someone should call me if anything changes. The trail may be muddy after rain. Please ask the driver to slow near loose gravel. We worry about slips. Is there a first aid kit? A driver contact helps. We can share it with trip leaders. Please confirm the return window today. Thanks again.
